author: Narayami
quote:
I will change my rating when rockstars decide to add a performance mode or a performance patch. Really? 2026 and not even stable 30fps? The fps drop makes the game a terrible experience. Not smooth at all. So much hype, so much time waiting for this game, so much money spent on this game for this disappointment.

Another thing I have to say, is that this doesn’t entirely feels like a GTA game. I don’t feel as much freedom as before. And thats GTA signature. Doing whatever we want. Also cant even go inside of most buildings.

But well, the main issue is the performance without a doubt.

author: Narayami
quote:
Once again Miyazaki didn’t disappoint.
Everyone in this game is perfect. Level design, music, movements, fighting… 

The exploration is rewarding and it feels so amazing to discover new places that are so beautiful. Fromsoftware and Miyazaki is the only company I can pre order a game and fully know I wont get disappointed.

author: Narayami
quote:
As a huge TLOU fan, after all this time, after a masterpiece, what is left is bitterness, sadness and disappointment.

Just to be clear the graphics and sound are amazing, the gameplay is good too, even so that its not that different from TLOU 1 (crafting, etc are basically the same).

But what really made me love TLOU was the story, the character development you see between joel and ellie, basically becoming father and daughter, how they start from strangers to become really attached and depending on each other, to the point that they would do anything for each other.

But its enough of talking about a masterpiece, so lets talk about TLOU part 2.
They tremendously failing on making/delivering a product that people actually wanted, and man... what a mess.

Ill try to be short:

So, we got to know a girl named Dina that I really don't have any interest in, she kissed ellie and she was dating Jesse but broke up a week before, and they loved each other so much that it seems they don't care about it anymore??? huuum okay, then they give us like a sex scene too between ellie and dina, and Jesse finds them and its all ok for him, like "I didn't even love her before".

Now, one of the most **** up thing in the story, our beloved joel that is really smart seems dumb now... so image if you kill hundreds of guys, you basically destroy the fireflies, you save an unknown person that is near your city(kinda weird) and she leads you to her friends, all armed in a room... would you tell your real name to them?? well, guess what, our now dummy Joel did! guess what happens? gets killed!.

To be honest, I was expecting Joel death in this game, but not like this, for what sake? the sake of shock? well, I have to give them credit at that, i was shocked.
But if you have the balls to do this, basically a cruel/idiotic plot death you have to make it up right?
well the return is a slap in your face.

The death of Joel could be, and deserved to be better than this.

After that Ellie goes on a rampage to get revenge on abby that killed Joel, she kills and kills and kills... then we get some playable flashbacks with joel and ellie, they were nice but not that good IMO.

Eventually you will know that abby had something with Owen, but now owen is with Mel, and Mel is pregnant, and later you see again abby doing sex with owen, and oh did I tell that Dina is also pregnant? Yeah! such a mess! wtf??? is this really TLOU??

Ok, so in the end you will have a background on Abby, and you will play a lot with her actually, so you can see that she is a good girl, good intentions, so you don't hate her for killing joel...

As I said, if Joel had a different death, and we knew a little more about Abby before, maybe, just maybe I would have some interest on that character. So they make you play with Abby, where she will find too a kid to protect like Joel, so simplistic and repetitive.
I really didn't like to play as Abby, I wish I had a skip option so I could skip to the ending, felt so pushy... Oh btw, how is she still alive with all the noise the makes walking??? jeez... oh, btw, amazing how ellie too doesn't care with the noise, she finds a guitar and starts playing like.... maybe there are clickers here?

So basically they put some non interesting characters as Abby, Dina, Jesse.... I couldn't care less About those Characters, at least not like this.

And well, after all this revenge story purpose, the pregnant girls, the sex, at the end Ellie lets Abby go. Yep, after all this messy story, after all the purpose is to get some revenge on Abby that killed Joel what you get is a slap in your face telling you that revenge is bad!

I understand the meaning, the circle or revenge wont end, revenge is bad, blablabla...
But its really unsatisfying, They really force you trying to like Abby, but with no success.
TLOU is an apocalyptic game, full of death, kill or get killed... doesn't really fit in the game... not that I don't understand the meaning or that Im a bad person, but felt really bad, unsatisfying story, unsatisfying ending.
poor Jesse that died in the end as nothing, irrelevant character right?

Imagine playing god of war and in the end kratos lets go zeus. yap. the same.

Well, as an fan of TLOU i feel really bad, I would like to rate it better, but I cant with this poor story.
I would recommend you to get the game only when its like 30$.

TL;DR: good graphics, good sound and gameplay, poor writing, poor characters, what leads to a bad story(that's where this game should shine). messy romantic/sex scenes, Forces you to like a character that you probably wont like. Get it when its on sale.

(I had this account here since I don't know when, and this is my first review... as a HUGE TLOU 1 fan I couldn't stay quiet about this.)
